mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, while tenofovir may affect renal function and alter tolterodine clearance; additionally, both drugs can cause anticholinergic and renal effects respectively, requiring monitoring in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function regularly and assess tolterodine efficacy/tolerability; adjust tolterodine dose if significant renal impairment develops; ensure adequate hydration and monitor for urinary retention.
